notes.title: ¡Nuwe Mac version released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282756/e0dfb4fda9fe35b3d95c291a11e4cfbfa9663fae.png[/img]Something strange is threatening life in the universe. It expands and extinguishes its light inexplicably.
[b]Nuwe[/b], the eternal planet, is the last hope for all life, and [b]Verken[/b] is the only guardian capable of entering dying planets and rescuing their life essence.
The adventure begins now on your Mac!
Delve into the mysteries of this epic adventure and enjoy the beautiful landscapes and the strange creatures that inhabit them.

If you like the Free Demo add Nuwe to your Steam wishlist!

The Nuwe team.

notes.title: Control System updated!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282756/f8640f1e3224bf542c48c544257c1051a9870aa1.png[/img]The grab button works now as a toggle button to ease controls.ːsteamhappyː
Arrow keys can be used to move the character now.
Some bugs were fixed.
